description: Figure 3 presents two side-by-side bar charts illustrating inter-annotator agreement, measured by Fleiss Kappa, across different levels of sample-level ambiguity. The left chart plots Fleiss Kappa on the vertical axis against sample-level ambiguity standard deviation (Ambiguity Std) on the horizontal axis, which is labeled with discrete values: 0.0, 0.47, 0.82, and 0.94. The corresponding Fleiss Kappa values for each bar are 0.88, 0.46, 0.03, and 0.24, respectively. The right chart similarly plots Fleiss Kappa on the vertical axis against sample-level maximum ambiguity (Max Ambiguity) on the horizontal axis, which is labeled with discrete integer values: 1, 2, and 3. The corresponding Fleiss Kappa values for each bar are 0.89, 0.46, and 0.23, respectively. Both charts use a single color for their bars, a solid dark blue, and the vertical axis is scaled linearly from 0.0 to 0.8. The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order of their respective x-axis labels.
